staticPrompts.prompt: Executes a subprocess; validate arguments, avoid shell interpolation, bound runtime, and propagate failures.
staticPrompts.reason: Fixed commands and argument arrays are passed to spawn without a shell; spawn, exit, JSON parse, and exact test-count failures propagate. The outer repository runner supplies the overall timeout.
staticPrompts.followUp: Keep invocation array-based and add an internal kill timer if this becomes a persistent unattended job.

staticPrompts.prompt: Contains destructive behavior; require dry-run, explicit scope, and recovery evidence.
staticPrompts.reason: Removal is restricted to a database and directory created by the same run with process/UUID or mkdtemp ownership; cleanup is in finally and never targets a caller-supplied filesystem path.
staticPrompts.followUp: Never point the configured test URL at production or weaken the unique-name, PostgreSQL-major, and dirty-tree guards.
